categories.name: validation
categories.evidence: Carries the Validation label and directly modifies block index initialization (`LoadBlockIndex`) and AssumeUTXO unlinked block state during startup.
categories.rationale: Fixes an unrecoverable crash loop on startup for nodes using AssumeUTXO. Without this fix, a node restarting after fetching the snapshot block out of order triggers an assertion failure in `FindMostWorkChain()` that requires a full `-reindex` and destroys the snapshot chainstate.
